description: This file defines a class `FormatDate` with a static method `format` that formats dates according to locale and timezone settings, utilizing PHP's IntlDateFormatter.

classes.name: FormatDate
classes.description: Provides date formatting functionality considering locale and timezone, using PHP's Internationalization extension.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a given date based on configuration's language setting, utilizing PHP's IntlDateFormatter. Falls back to 'en' locale and 'GMT' timezone if 'intl' extension is not loaded.
